title: Business Insights offices: configuring an office and organization- and office-level occupancy and attendance goals

prose.label: Goals.
prose.text: {{goal-values}} {{goal-meaning}} The office capacity that other articles use for occupancy differs {{divergence:goal-denominator}}.
How the metrics are calculated and displayed is in [[business-insights.workplace]]; the product overview is in [[business-insights.overview]].

read-only-admin.statement: An admin account with read-only access to Business Insights can only view offices and their configuration details.

quotes: An admin account with read-only access to Business Insights can only view the offices and use the View icon to view office configuration details.

capacity-and-headcount.statement: In an office, Capacity (employees the office can accommodate) helps calculate occupancy and Assigned Headcount (users assigned to the office) helps calculate attendance.

quotes: Capacity: Enter the number of employees the office can accommodate. This value helps calculate the occupancy of the office.
Assigned Headcount: Enter the number of users that you want to assign to the office. This value helps calculate the attendance metrics for the office.

locations-and-ips.statement: A configured office is associated with Internet & SaaS locations and sublocations (new Internet & SaaS locations appear in the Locations field after one day) and with IP addresses, entered comma-separated.

quotes: Locations: Select the Internet & SaaS locations and sublocations that you want to associate with this office.
IP Addresses: Enter the IP addresses associated with the office.
Any new location added for Internet & SaaS is reflected in this field after one day.
You can enter multiple IP addresses using commas to separate each IP address.

tag-limit.statement: At most 8 tags can be manually linked to an office.

quotes: You can only manually link a maximum of 8 tags.

delete-office-effect.statement: Deleting an office stops data aggregation for it, and metrics are then displayed for each Internet & SaaS location, sublocation and IP address individually.

quotes: If you delete the office, the Business Insights service stops data aggregation for the office and initiates the display of metrics for each Internet & SaaS location, sublocation, and IP address individually.

goal-values.statement: The occupancy goal is entered as a value between 1 and 100, and the attendance goal as 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 days per week; goals can be set at organization level or per office.

quotes: You can set organization-level occupancy and attendance goals
enter the occupancy goal between 1 and 100
In the Attendance Goal Percentage field, enter the attendance goal (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively).
Individual office goals can be configured in the respective office's Edit Office drawers.
Occupancy Goal Percentage: Enter the occupancy goal between 1 and 100.

goal-meaning.statement: The organization-level goals article says that an occupancy goal of 60 means offices are expected to be occupied by at least 60% of their assigned users, and that an attendance goal of 40 means users are expected in the office at least 2 days per week.

quotes: if the occupancy goal is set to 60, the offices are expected to be occupied by at least 60% of their assigned users
if the attendance goal is set to 40, the users are expected to come into the office at least 2 days per week.

tag-purpose.statement: The 2025 release summary says the Tag Management feature links workplaces to user-defined tags, which can be used as a filtering option for viewing workplace insights.

quotes: You can use the Tag Management feature to link workplaces to user-defined tags. These tags can be used as a filtering option for viewing workplace insights.

office-list-fields.statement: The Offices list shows Size in square feet, Lease Status (leased or owned) and the BSSIDs associated with the office.

quotes: Size: The size of the office in square feet.
Lease Status: Indicates whether the office building is leased or owned.
BSSIDs: The BSSIDs associated with the office.

goal-denominator.summary: The occupancy goal articles measure occupancy against an office's assigned users, while the office configuration and terminology articles calculate occupancy from Capacity.

quotes: if you set the occupancy to 30, the office is expected to be occupied by at least 30% of its assigned users.

positions.says: An occupancy goal is described as the share of an office's assigned users expected to occupy it.

quotes: Average Occupancy: The average occupancy for a workplace is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the site capacity, then multiplying it by 100.

positions.says: Average Occupancy is the total visits divided by the site capacity, times 100.

quotes: Capacity: Enter the number of employees the office can accommodate. This value helps calculate the occupancy of the office.

positions.says: Capacity, not Assigned Headcount, is the office value that helps calculate occupancy.

goal-denominator.impact: Whether an occupancy goal is compared against assigned users or against Capacity is not stated; the goal articles and the occupancy formulas name different denominators.

office-fields.title: How BSSIDs and tags are set on an office
office-fields.detail: BSSIDs appear in the Offices list but not among the fields described for adding an office; tags are described as a filter for workplace insights, but the configuring-an-office article does not say so.
